\noindent\footnotesize \textit{Note:} Panel A is one row per exposure or per placebo null, on the same cohort and control set. Rows one to three are clustered linear-probability estimates; rows four to six are null distributions over 2,000 draws, so their bracketed pair is the 2.5 to 97.5 percentile of the null, not a confidence interval. The permuted-anchor null is centred near the observed estimate (+16.8 pp against an observed +17.3 pp), and the frozen verdict recorded with the analysis is NOT\_SPECIFIC\_ANCHORING\_NULL\_REPRODUCES\_ESTIMATE. Panel B shares are of the 105 user-written edges among the 128 exposure events; the rule and the hand reading disagree on 10 of 105 texts (9.5\%), always conservatively. Its subgroup contrasts are description, not a causal decomposition. Panel C scores the four pre-registered heuristics and two combination rules on the 80 user accounts behind the 105 user-written edges, using 7,141 of their earlier comments. An account is flagged when it trips at least two heuristics. The median machine-likeness score is 0.198 and the maximum is 0.471. Of the 105 edge texts, 102 are distinct after normalisation and the most repeated text appears 3 times; hand reading of the 20 highest-scoring accounts finds that repetition to be hand-issued agent invocations and platform button text rather than generated output. Per-account scores and the hand-review sheet are in the public artifact.
